messages:
maya: FYI renewal for NimbusHealth landed. They're requesting Net60 and want to convert 10 seats to Dedicated. Quote: https://drive.redwood/nimbus/renewal_q2.xlsx
sam: Net60 is outside policy. Who is the payer contact?
eli: Payer is Nimbus Procurement (procurement@nimbus.com). Last year was Net30. Finance flags Net60 needs approval.
maya: Proposing Net45 + 60% upfront to keep things moving. Can procurement generate PO if they accept?
finance: Net45 OK with 60% upfront. Need PO and VAT/tax ID for UK billing entity switch.
procurement-bot: DocuSign envelope #8921 created by maya (status: sent).
maya: Client says DocuSign is blocked by their SSO. Trying an alternative browser.
lucy (external): SSO blocks pop-up; testing incognito now.
eli: If DocuSign fails, offer wet-signature or e-sign via our CSM Zoom. Which is faster?
maya: They prefer wet-sign if SSO won't allow. I re-sent with ID verification off.
legal: Added clause for Dedicated seat billing and upfront payment. Attaching addendum to envelope.
account-exec: I'm OK with Net45 + 60% given account expansion. Finance confirm?
finance: Confirmed. After signature we'll issue invoice referencing PO + wire details.
maya: VAT uploaded to ticket CS-5599. Updating renewal tracker -> "awaiting signature (SSO)"; risk = "medium". I'll follow up hourly. :white_check_mark:
_meta: Generated per agents.md: Slack thread JSON for customer-success renewal execution (pricing, term changes, procurement, signatures).
